relationships.subject: capsaicin 8% topical system
relationships.evidence_quote: A 30 min application of the capsaicin 8% topical system can provide sustained (up to 3 months) local pain relief by desensitizing and reducing TRPV1-expressing cutaneous fibers.

key_findings: Capsaicin 8% topical system gives sustained local relief in painful diabetic neuropathy of the feet via desensitization of TRPV1 fibers
